title: Switching clouds takes two steps: Disconnect, then Connect the other, so the switch is not one state (S3 PR 3)
evidence: Proposed in the S3 PR 2 design delta: a switchRequested(P) event, then closing with a follow-on P, in CloudConnection (ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudConnection.swift refuseAnother). Retires "Disconnect from <cloud> first, then connect <other>." and the welcome sheet's "Use a different cloud" (US-25 AC11l, US-54 AC2d). Changes user-visible flow on both clients: needs web parity (widget-src/standalone/connect.ts prepareSwitch, with lead A9 on the same picker), its own design delta and a UI-thread check of the words
